objects: current permanent with the typed ability
timing: the entry choice occurs before battlefield mutation
block legality reads current counters when the complete declaration is proposed
choices: the affected object's prospective controller independently applies or declines each Unleash instance
hidden_information: only the choosing seat receives the replacement task; the choice and resulting public counter are journaled
apnap: simultaneous affected-object choices use the canonical replacement APNAP coordinator
layers: granted, lost, copied, or face-down Unleash requires trusted typed ability propagation
replacement_effects: the optional entry ability and resulting counter quantity replacements share one immutable precommit tree
copy: ordinary copies require the represented copied-ability boundary
control_change: the prospective destination controller makes the entry choice and controls the entered permanent
zone_change: each new battlefield entry receives a fresh optional replacement opportunity
source_leaves: the block prohibition ends immediately when the permanent leaves or no longer has the named counter

known_blockers: granted, copied, lost, and face-down Unleash requires trusted typed ability propagation
unrepresented zone and counter replacement families remain fail-closed
aggregate counters, replacement effects, and blocking restrictions remain incomplete
